Whale and Wasp is the fifth track off of Jar of Flies.

It is a beautifully written composition, consisting of harmonizing electric guitars as the lead instrument, as well as acoustic guitars for backing. Like the other songs on the album, the acoustic guitars are given a chorus effect for a fuller sound.

This song was also used on the DVD menu for Music Bank: The Videos.

  


[Migrated instrumental annotation:]
This instrumental is one of the deepest. The painful “wail” of the guitar, like a voice crying out in agony, reverberating through time, possibly like the sound of and addict’s cry for help. This sound also sounds like a literal whale’s call underwater, suggesting that maybe Staley’s drowning in his addiction.

The wasp is the sound of the steel guitar rhythm we hear that has a stinging vibration sound. Possibly representing the pain of coming off of a high.
